brief: Five hard truths about making money with AI. The hype tax, the saturation problem, the moat question every solo founder must answer.

slots.scriptTagline: The hype tax, the moat, and the saturation trap.

slots.body: You are bleeding money on subscriptions and tokens before you earn a single dollar. The AI stack is cheap until it isn't. Most solo founders pay a luxury tax on hope, not revenue.
AI lowered the barrier to entry for everyone, not just you. That brilliant idea you had yesterday was launched by three people last week. Saturation is the new default.
If your entire business is a ChatGPT wrapper, you own nothing. Prompts are not intellectual property. You need audience, data, or distribution to survive the clone wars.
Building the tool takes a weekend. Getting one thousand people to care takes a year. Most solo founders quit before the algorithm ever notices them.
Blind automation without oversight creates public mistakes at scale. One bad hallucination in front of a client destroys credibility faster than AI can write an apology.
Prompts multiply output but they do not multiply judgment. At some point leverage requires people, not just better models. The solo ceiling is real and unforgiving.

slots.headline: BUILD WHAT THEY CANNOT COPY
slots.scriptTagline: Solo founders who survive build assets, not wrappers.
